messages:
nora: Quick summary from customer interviews (AtlasHealth, QueryLabs): main asks are per-route cost visibility and a one-click path from error rows to the trace. They stressed they'd accept a basic export or webhook while we build a full explorer. I'm proposing a narrow MVP to unblock them.

tia: Love the unblock approach. can you sketch concrete MVP vs follow-up spelled out? also want launch gates spelled out (accuracy + perf).

nora: MVP proposal: 
- UI: "Cost snapshot" card (7d/30d toggle) + top-12 tenants by spend + simple error table with a trace button.
- Data: emit trace_id into our metrics envelope at emit time so the UI can open the trace by id. store only a pointer (no extra trace copies). default sampling 1% globally, tenant override for Dedicated.
- Export: CSV export endpoint for cost rows + webhook alpha for spike alerts.

ben: Engineering constraints: writing trace_id into metrics is low-risk. We'll need a small index to map metric->trace_id->trace URL. estimate: 
- trace_id plumbing + UI link: 6 dev-days
- cost snapshot UI + CSV endpoint: 4 dev-days
- alert webhook prototype: 2 dev-days
- infra indexing + retention tweak: 3 dev-days
approx total across teams: ~15 dev-days.

matt: Ops note: add privacy and billing copy: label numbers "estimated" and link to billing console. Also we need a feature flag and a kill-switch. Ops can add a temporary in-flight sampling override to reduce traces if we see unexpected load. ops-bot will create the runbook stub.

tia: Launch acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Accuracy: snapshot spend within 5% of billing for top-20 tenants over 7d sample
- UX: trace-button opens the correct trace in <=2s for sampled traces 95% of the time
- Perf: cost snapshot render p95 <600ms under normal load
- Reliability: CSV and webhook success rate >=99% in canary
- Privacy: data surface audit signed off

nora: Tests to add: an automated billing replay that feeds synthetic requests and validates the cost snapshot numbers (for the 5% gate), plus an e2e that clicks the trace-button and asserts the trace_id lookup returns the expected trace URL. Also emit telemetry events: cost_card_view, csv_export, trace_open, alert_fired.

product-bot: Created ticket RD-53221: "console: compact-obs MVP (cost snapshot + trace link + CSV + webhook alpha)" assigned to @ben, due 2026-05-01.

ben: I'll break RD-53221 into subtasks with owners + estimates by EOD.

nora: Rollout plan: internal dogfood -> 3 pilot customers (AtlasHealth, QueryLabs, BetaDev) for 1 week -> expand to a 20-customer early access cohort -> GA. We'll gate expansion on the accuracy + UX gates. Keep v2 (route-level token breakouts, explorer UI, 30d retention) for Q3.

matt: I'll prepare the kill-switch + sampling override and the infra ticket for indexing. ops-bot: please create the runbook and the privacy intake.

ops-bot: Runbook stub created: redwood.obs_compact_mvp_runbook. Privacy intake ticket RD-53222 opened and assigned to legal.

tia: Good. let's keep scope tight. this will give customers meaningful visibility quickly and buy us time for the heavier route-level work. demo in next product sync please. :thumbsup:

nora: Thanks — action items captured. follow-up updates in RD-53221.
